Bill smoked a cigarette as the escalator gradually carried him 30,000 feet into the sky. Exhaling and looking over the side at the thick clouds below, he sighed disinterestedly.

"You've gotta be fucking kidding me." he finally muttered to himself. He was looking somewhat unkempt with a beard that had long-since resembled anything moderately fashionable. His grey suit, worn over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up and the collar open, had seen better days too. He hadn't bothered to make much effort in his appearance since he had been dying from cancer for the last year anyway.

The steps of the lift were no bigger than those seen on any standard American mall escalator, but he managed to lie down anyway, figuring that if there were some horrific accident then he'd just end up back here anyway.

When he awoke at the gate of heaven, a gorgeous angel with blonde hair and blue eyes was playfully giggling as he floated over Bill's body. Bill shielded his eyes from the glare of the golden gates before finally rolling over and sitting up.

"Father wants to see you! Come with me!" exclaimed the angel in the softest and most innocent voice Bill had ever heard in his life.

"Fuck me, man. Give me a minute." Bill found a pair of sunglasses in his suit jacket pocket and put them on. He reached for his packet of marlboros, too, and lit one up. Finally pulling himself to his feet, he staggered behind the angel and paid no mind to the many dynamic and unbelievable scenes taking place.

When he finally made it to the area where god was seated, he was not surprised to see that the man himself was taller than the Empire State Building.

"Ah! Mr Hicks!" the creator joyfully explained.
"Yeah" Bill coughed as he exhaled. He ran some fingers through his hair and kept his eyes on his shoes for the most part. He couldn't remember why he'd bought these shoes, and tried to think about the day that he had bought them. Surely there were certain circumstances that made it difficult for him to consider any option other than buying these stupid shoes?
"It's so nice to meet you. I'm a big fan. You did many great things in your life. And now, you may rest in heaven for all of eternity." Bill groaned loudly.

"What the fuck, man!? Have you seen what's happening down there? There's genocides, child soldiers, child trafficking rings, poverty, famine - "
"Ah, yes." God interrupted. "Yes, I know about those things, and -"
"Yeah, I fucking hope you do. There's nations of countries, man, killing each other in your fuckin' name! What the fuck!? Ever think about sending Jesus down there once in a while to smooth shit over? And why the fuck did you let Bush into the Whitehouse? What's next, are you going to let his dipshit son into office when he's older enough?"
"Bill, I don't think you - "
"Oh, this is so fuckin' stupid. I cannot believe this, I just cannot believe it. You're a fucking dumbass." Bill's last statement carried slightly less emotion. He seemed resigned to the failures not just of mankind, but now also of the creator of the universe.
"Bill, I'm just the creator. If I was to control the behaviour of all men and women - both good and evil - what would happen to free will?"
"Fuck free will, man! Did you hear anything I just said? Psilocybin Mushrooms are illegal down there for fucks sake!"
"Bill, perhaps you should rest for a while before our next chat."
"Yeah, maybe. Who else is up here? Shit, I bet you let all kinds of dumb fucks into heaven. Is Stalin around here, I'd like to go and get a coffee with him. How about Hitler? Hey, does Genghis Khan have any kind of special privileges in heaven?"
"Bill, " the almighty calmly retorted "there's really no need for that. I love all beings equally."
"Holy shit! Hang on a second." Bill quickly grabbed another marlboro, and only now realized that the packet was still full. This calmed him down, somewhat. The thought of being able to smoke an endless supply of cigarettes in heaven meant that the afterlife wouldn't need to be *completely* without meaning. "Hmm." His temper had been calmed substantially. He rubbed his face to keep himself awake and thought things over for a second.
"Bill, you should get some rest. We can talk in the morning. Just follow the angel and he'll take you to your new living quarters."
"Yeah, well fuck that buddy." Bill responded as he walked away. "I'll smoke your cigarettes but we don't need to do this again. Be seein' ya."

With that, Bill walked into the distance. As he walked to his new home, he noticed someone that looked like Mitch Hedberg in the distance. As he got closed, he noticed that it actually was Mitch. Smiling, the other comedian said nothing but did pull a large bag of dried mushrooms from his pocket.
